🤖 Groq API Keys
The built-in keys are used first. Add extra keys here as fallback — they are tried in order when the primary keys hit rate limits.
✨ Gemini API Keys
Extra Gemini keys used as additional fallback after Groq keys are exhausted.
ℹ️ Translation cascade
Order: Built-in Groq keys → Your extra Groq keys → Built-in Gemini → Your extra Gemini keys → MyMemory (free fallback)

Keys are stored locally in VS Code's secure storage and never sent anywhere except the respective API endpoint.
